msg_value.meaning: Native value (msg.value) supplied with the unstake() call.

fee_native_fee.meaning: Exact native fee for the unstake message returned by _quote (fee.nativeFee).

buffered_fee.meaning: Fee returned by quoteUnstakeWithBuffer(), deliberately larger than the exact quote.

call_reverts_native_mismatch.meaning: unstake() reverts with OAppSender.NotEnoughNative(uint256) because msg.value does not equal the native fee expected by _payNative.

lz_message_sent.meaning: A LayerZero cross-chain unstake message is dispatched by _lzSend.

claims.scope: Single UnstakeMessenger.unstake() invocation on the spoke chain following the buffered-fee integration pattern.

preconditions.text: Caller obtains bufferedFee from quoteUnstakeWithBuffer() and invokes unstake() forwarding exactly that bufferedFee as msg.value, where msg.value strictly exceeds the exact quoted fee.nativeFee.
preconditions.derivation: Conjunction of the buffered-fee integration precondition (msg.value equals the buffered helper result) and the overpayment precondition (msg.value strictly greater than fee.nativeFee).

safety.text: In the intended system, if msg.value is at or above the exact quoted native fee, unstake() must not abort on the LayerZero native-fee equality check (overpayment is accepted; excess refunded).
safety.derivation: Intended behavior taken from the security intent: the buffered flow requires accepting msg.value at or above fee.nativeFee. The refund-forwarding half of the intent is not expressible here and is left unresolved.

effects.text: The call reverts with OAppSender.NotEnoughNative(uint256) and no LayerZero unstake message is dispatched.
effects.derivation: Alleged effect: the overpaid buffered call fails the strict-equality native-fee check inside _payNative, reverting before dispatch.

effect_coverage.reason: Encoded as a bounded single-call revert with no dispatch; the universal 'every buffered unstake' quantification is not expressible.
Pattern-level unusability is a design consequence; the single-call revert is its witness but full pattern coverage is not a single-call fact.
User/population-level inability is not reducible to one call; only the witnessing revert is encoded.

assumptions: as_excess_is_refunded: excess msg.value is recoverable via the refund address; not used as a premise and contradicted when the call reverts before any refund.
unresolved: Whether excess msg.value is ever forwarded/refunded to the caller's refund address (revert precedes dispatch).
Exact upper bound and full set of overpayment values tested.
LayerZero OAppSender version(s)/chain(s) where _payNative enforces strict equality.
Whether the strict-equality constraint affects other UnstakeMessenger entrypoints.

claims.scope: Spoke-chain cross-chain unstake UX path across continued buffered-pattern use.

preconditions.text: Integrators continue to follow the buffered-fee pattern exposed by UnstakeMessenger.
preconditions.derivation: Continued use of the buffered pattern is the report's stated condition for persistent failures; the numeric overpayment relation is already captured in the core claim.

safety.text: A primary cross-chain unstake UX path should not remain persistently unusable for users.
safety.derivation: No security_intent statement sources a persistence-scope obligation; left null/unresolved rather than inventing a free Boolean.

effects.text: Users may be unable to complete buffered cross-chain unstakes persistently until the integration is adjusted.
effects.derivation: Potential, persistent, population-scoped effect; not expressible as a bounded single-call constraint.

effect_coverage.reason: Potential persistence/UX-scope effect cannot be encoded with bounded single-call AST; kept null.

unresolved: Duration and breadth of persistent user-facing failures across the buffered flow.

limitations: Deferred impact i_integrators_forced_to_exact_fee: timing/gas-price fragility between quote and execution is economic/temporal and not expressible in the allowed AST; no formula claim generated.
Deferred impact i_no_direct_fund_loss: the report asserts no fund loss, so there is no bad economic effect to formalize and no loss symbol is invented.
Impact i_all_buffered_unstakes_revert is population-scoped; coverage is partial because only a single-call revert is encoded.
Impacts i_buffered_pattern_unusable and i_users_cannot_complete_buffered_unstake are design/user-population-scoped; only the witnessing single-call revert is encoded (partial).
Impact i_primary_ux_path_broken is formalized only as a potential, null/unformalized claim; persistence scope is unsupported.
The intended refund of excess native value (si_overpay_then_refund_should_work) is not witnessed by the bad outcome, which reverts before any refund; this mismatch is flagged, not resolved.
No malicious actor is described; the report frames an integration/design mismatch, so no adversarial precondition or economic attack path is formalized.
The intended fix (accept overpayment vs alter the fee argument passed to _lzSend) is not specified by the report.
